exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Could you do something for me?".

options.text: Verb てもらえませんか
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb てもらえませんか matches "Could you do something for me?".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb てもらえませんか.
exercises.explanation: Polite way to request someone to do something for you.
